36C24126Q0440 INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE

THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION OR REQUEST FOR OFFERS. NO SOLICITATION PACKAGE IS AVAILABLE AND TELEPHONE REQUESTS WILL NOT BE HONORED AND NO SOLICITATION WILL BE POSTED TO CONTRACT OPPORTUNITIES.

PROCUREMENT TITLE: REPLACE OBSOLETE/DISCONTINUED STRYKER 8™ SYSTEM

INTENT TO AWARD: The Department of Veterans Affairs, VISN 01, VAHCS West Haven, 950 Campbell Avenue, West Haven, CT 06516-2770, intends to award one (1) Order under FSS 36F79720D0041, to the SDVOSB TrillaMed LLC, to replace the Obsolete/Discontinued items described below.

DESCRIPTION: This requirement seeks to replace the Obsolete/Discontinued Stryker 8™ System handpieces and batteries System; and replace Obsoleted/Discontinued items with the Stryker 9™ System. Due to advances in technology and the development of more current surgical power tools, the following Stryker 8™ System handpieces and batteries will be discontinued; and to be replaced with the Stryker 9™ System (See attached notice for list of discontinued & replacement items):

DELIVERY: 25 Calendar days after Receipt of Order.

NAICS: 339113   Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing. Size standard 800 Employees

PSC: 6515 Medical Equipment and Accessories and Supplies

AUTHORITY: The authority for this procurement will be via FAR Part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed award upon response to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer.

INTERESTED PARTIES: Any Contractor who believes that they have experience and capability to fulfill this requirement may express interest by submitting a written capability statement or letter of interest to pearl.wray@va.gov  by 4/27/2026 and by 1400 EST. Any questions related to this notice can also be sent to pearl.wray@va.gov
